entities.summary: Iman Al Sayed, is a Palestinian artist whose work focuses on processes and repetition. She probes and investigates the human condition and the sociopolitical effects caused by displacement. Al Sayed uses various media in her work, varying from sculptures and installations to moving images, sound and words.
